sources.title: Blue Moon Valley 2026: How to Visit (8 Useful Tips) - China Highlights
sources.content:
Blue Moon Valley 2026: Complete Information

Main Attractions
Blue Moon Valley features "four blue lakes and the White Water Terraces, where the clear White Water River cascades down the terraces." Visitors can "stroll along the lakeside plank trails and capture stunning photos featuring both the snowcapped mountains and the blue lakes."

Best Photography Spot
"Among the four blue lakes, Yuye Lake is the bluest and the best spot for capturing photos of the blue lake alongside the snow peaks." After exiting the sightseeing bus, walk a short distance to reach it.

Optimal Visiting Times
Visit "on a sunny day as sunlight serves as the best filter." The ideal window is "between 11am and 2pm when the sunlight is most abundant." Best months: March-May and October-December offer "more sunshine and less rainfall."

Location & Access
Blue Moon Valley sits within Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, approximately one hour's drive from Lijiang Old Town. Transport options include sightseeing buses from the tourist center or transfers from Glacier Park, Spruce Meadow, or Yak Meadow.

Recommended Routes
For half-day visits: "Spruce Meadow -> Blue Moon Valley" suits most visitors, avoiding serious altitude concerns. Full-day options add Glacier Park (October-April for snow) or Yak Meadow (3,700 meters elevation, fewer crowds).

Duration: Allow "1-1.5 hours" for photography and strolling.

Tickets: No separate admission required; included in Jade Dragon Snow Mountain entrance fee.

Altitude Considerations
Located at 2,900 meters with abundant vegetation and relatively high oxygen levels. Flat terrain minimizes altitude sickness risks.

sources.title: Visiting the Blue Moon Valley in Lijiang China, Best Views in all of China! - Feastography
sources.content:
Visiting the Blue Moon Valley in Lijiang China, Best Views in all of China!

Author: James Kaewanan | Date: Apr 25

In the province of Yunnan, China near the city of Lijiang, there exists the most beautiful view your pair of eyes will ever see.

Situated below the towering beauty of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain are a set of lakes collectively known as the Blue Moon Valley. Even though I have just been to the previously mentioned mountain, the Blue Moon Valley takes the award for being the most beautiful natural scenic views I ever had the pleasure of seeing.

The Blue Moon Valley's Many Lakes
The Blue Moon Valley consists of 5 lakes of which you can admire from 3 scenic viewpoints dotted along the valley. The lakes are: Tingtao Lake, Blue Moon Lake, Jingtan Lake, Yuye Lake, and the Baishui Lake. Of which the Yuye Lake is the biggest (and main) one.

There is a road bridge running across Yuye Lake, imagine driving across and admiring the view on both sides.

Blue Moon Valley Shuttle Bus
When you first arrive at the visitor center of the Blue Moon Valley, you'll need to take a shuttle bus uphill to reach the actual valley. These cost 20 RMB and allow you to hop on and hop off at all 3 scenic viewpoints.

Pristine Scenic Views
The Blue Moon Valley truly is beautiful, especially at the first Yuye Lake viewpoint. The pictures cannot showcase the real awe-inspiring beauty of the scenery. It's just so picturesque with the gorgeous towering Yulong Mountains looming over in the background.

Another scenic viewpoint that might come close is the Tiger Leaping Gorge on the opposite side of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, near Shangri-La.

The rock formations representing steps are impressive - the author has never seen such formations before.

The water in these lakes is pristine and bright blue.

Environmental Concerns
Trash is disgustingly littered throughout the valley - oxygen canisters, plastic bottles everywhere, especially near the railings around the lake. Silver light reflector sheets were seen lying at the floor of the lake.

At 2 viewpoints you can spot a pure white Tibetan Yak with only about less than 10,000 still left on Earth. These creatures are captured for tourist photo opportunities.

Details About the Blue Moon Valley
Location: Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang, Yunnan, China, 674106
Opening Hours: 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM | Mon - Sun
Entrance Fee: 100 RMB (+ 20 RMB for the shuttle bus)

How to Get There from Lijiang City
To get to the Blue Moon Valley you must first go to the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain - they're within the same scenic park.
- Tourist bus from South Gate of Lijiang Ancient Town: 40 RMB
- Public bus Number 7 from Hong Tai Yang Square: 15 RMB
Once at the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Visitor center, purchase an entrance ticket, then take the shuttle bus to the Blue Moon Valley.

sources.title: Blue Moon Valley Lijiang: Getting there without a tour - Museum of Wander
sources.content:
Blue Moon Valley Travel Guide

The Blue Moon Valley near Lijiang in Yunnan Province features "ice blue lakes, pine forests, glacier filled mountains and clear blue skies." Located at the foot of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, this valley contains four crystal-clear blue lakes fed by melting glacier water from the 5,600-meter peak.

Quick Reference Details
Visited: December
Recommended Duration: Half a day
Distance from Lijiang: 15 kilometers
Park Rating: AAAAA (China's highest scenic rating)

Transportation Instructions
From Lijiang's old town, walk to the Mao Zedong Statue where minivan number 7 departs regularly. "Minivan 7 is the ride you need to take. Tickets cost between RMB 20-30 per seat." The 30-minute ride leads to the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain entrance. "Entrance fee to the park is RMB 100."

At the main building, "Buses leave from the main building to the Blue Moon Valley every 10-20 minutes between 07:00 - 17:00 and cost RMB 15."

Alternatively, taxi service costs approximately 100 RMB.

Essential Requirements
Visitors must carry their passport - entry is denied without it.

Practical Tips
Timing: Arrive before 7 AM to avoid extreme crowds. By 9 AM, conditions become "unbearable."
Crowds: "Cross the footbridge to the opposite side of the lakes when it gets too busy. Most visitors hang around main vantage points with selfie sticks."
Supplies: Pack snacks and beverages from Lijiang, as on-site shops are overpriced.
Photos: Local Naxi traditional clothing rentals available for cultural photography experiences.

sources.title: Lijiang Blue Moon Valley: What to See & Getting There - ChinaXianTour
sources.content:
Blue Moon Valley Lijiang: What to See & Getting There

Blue Moon Valley is a stunning part of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in Lijiang, China. It is an extremely blue river meandering through a lush valley between Ganhaizi and Spruce Meadow, mainly composed of four large turquoise lakes and dozens of miniature white waterfalls.

Location: Within Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, 31km from Lijiang Old Town, about a 1-hour drive.

Main Attractions: Four distinctively charming lakes - Yuye Lake, Jingtan Lake, Blue Moon Lake, and Tingtao Lake. Among them, Yuye Lake is the bluest and best spot for photos.

Getting There: Take Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Special Line 101 at Bailong Square of Lijiang Old Town to the tourist center, costing CNY 15, taking 1.5 hours. Then take a sightseeing bus at the visitors' center to the valley; fare is CNY 20.

Best Time to Visit: On a sunny day, between 11am and 2pm when sunlight is most abundant. For month selection, March to May and October to December are better choices.

Visiting Tips: Aim for 7 AM arrival for serene beauty before main tourist influx.

sources.title: Blue Moon Valley, White Water River, Lijiang - Travel China Guide
sources.content:
Blue Moon Valley / White Water River

Blue Moon Valley is located at the entrance of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, 31km from Lijiang Old Town. It was originally called White Water River (白水河) because the riverbed is composed of white marble and limestone fragments.

The valley got its current name because on sunny days, the water appears blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped like a moon, making it look like a blue moon nestled at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. The name also references James Hilton's novel Lost Horizon and its Blue Moon Valley.

The river forms four major lakes: Yuye Lake (Jade Liquid Lake), Jingtan Lake (Mirror Pool Lake), Lanyue Lake (Blue Moon Lake), and Tingtao Lake (Listening Wave Lake).

The water contains copper ions and is not drinkable. The distinctive blue-green color comes from the minerals dissolved in the glacial meltwater.

sources.title: 蓝月谷风景区 - 百度百科
sources.content:
蓝月谷风景区 - 完整内容提取

基本信息
蓝月谷风景区位于云南省丽江市玉龙县玉龙雪山东麓。气候条件属于亚热带季风气候。主要景点包括玉液湖、镜潭湖、蓝月湖和听涛湖。

形成原因
"蓝月谷是由丽江玉龙雪山冰川消融后不断汇集山涧、溪流，最终在上游深谷中形成的河流。"

命名历史
蓝月谷最初名为"白水河"。因河床由灰白色大理石、石灰石碎块组成，清泉流过呈灰白色而得名。后因英国作家詹姆斯·希尔顿笔下《消失的地平线》中的蓝月亮山谷相似，故改名为"蓝月谷"。

水文特征："蓝月谷的水中含有铜离子，不能饮用。"

方位布局
风景区共建设6个景观拦砂坝，形成近26万立方米水体，打造四大景观湖泊。

主要景点

玉液湖："水质十分清澈，蓝色的湖水中倒影着玉龙雪山，像极了一幅美妙的山水画卷。"
镜潭湖：小巧恬静，"湖水特别清澈，宛如九寨沟镜海的味道。"
蓝月湖："被繁茂绿树环绕，碧绿透彻。"
听涛湖："湖水落差很大，溪流泻过犹如飞瀑，发出响声。"

开发建设
2006年，玉龙雪山管委会投资开发蓝月谷景点。建设完成3500米电瓶车道、5700米步行游道，近25000平方米景观绿化。

旅游信息
距离：距丽江城区约25公里
交通方式：
- 公交：从丽江古城南门步行10分钟到忠义市场站，乘101路雪山专线
- 自驾：需导航至玉龙雪山游客中心，乘大巴到蓝月谷
- 打车：约40分钟

游玩路线：在"水月阁"站下车，沿栈道漫步，观看听涛湖、镜潭湖、蓝月湖、玉液湖、白水台等景观。

sources.title: 云南旅游——玉龙雪山蓝月谷游玩攻略 - 知乎
sources.content:
玉龙雪山蓝月谷游玩攻略

蓝月谷最初名为"白水河"，因河床、台地都由灰白色大理石、石灰石碎块组成。在晴天时，水的颜色是蓝色的，而且山谷呈月牙形，远看就像一轮蓝色的月亮镶嵌在玉龙雪山脚下，所以名叫蓝月谷。

河水在流淌过程中因受山体阻挡，形成了四个较大的水面："玉液"湖、"镜潭"湖、"蓝月"湖和"听涛"湖。

最佳游玩时间：5-9月去蓝月谷，景色更加迷人。最好看的时间段是中午11-14点，蓝月谷美不美主要看当天的天气，阳光是最好的滤镜。

交通方式：距离丽江城区大概25km左右，当天可来回（要导航到玉龙雪山游客中心，然后坐大巴到蓝月谷，不能直接开车到蓝月谷）。

门票信息：蓝月谷属于雪山景区，所以到达蓝月谷必须要在进山处缴纳100元/人的进山门票费。

游览路线：在景区大巴车的第二站"水月阁"下车，后沿着栈道漫步，一路上能看到听涛湖、镜潭湖、蓝月湖、玉液湖、白水台以及一些不知名的小湖。
